meta.reconstruction_warning: Treat reconstructed weeks as approximate, not as a track record. We tested how far a rebuild drifts by rebuilding week 4, a week we did publish live. The rebuild produced 20 picks going 10-10; the card that actually went out had 17 picks and went 8-9. Five picks appeared that were never bet, two real picks vanished, and eight lines moved by a point. The cause is that the line data available for a past week is not the line the model saw before kickoff. The live-only record above is the number to judge this model on.

prediction.claim: Model Unders on teams with combined garbage-time share above 0.20 hit under 50%, against a 52.4% break-even.

trend.claim: Model picks where the team totals trend fights the pick hit under 52.4%; picks it agrees with or has no trend on do better.
